objective: Make the Revision D mechanical specification, SCAD, CadQuery STEP exports, analytical load cases, and mechanical verification evidence share one coordinate system and fail when generated geometry diverges from the controlled raised and stowed heights.
acceptance: ground, base-top, stowed-height, lift-travel, torso, arm, neck, and head datums are explicit
the generated raised assembly STEP top matches the 1450 mm controlled height within tolerance
navigation and stabilized manipulation use separate center-of-gravity and support-polygon load cases
SCAD and CadQuery use the same Revision D lift and body datums
all physical fit, collision, stability, thermal, braking, and drop evidence remains explicitly NOT_EXECUTED or PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_REQUIRED
mechanical package tests, Ruff, and Task Packet validation pass
stop_conditions: the repair requires selecting supplier components or claiming physical test evidence
the repair requires changing robot control, firmware, interfaces, PCB, or safety ownership
the generated STEP cannot be measured with the available deterministic CAD runtime
